title: Added calculation QC workpapers to answer tables
points: Analyst answers now include a deterministic calculation breakdown table when retrieved statement, ratio, or valuation tables support formula-level QC.
The breakdown shows the metric formula, numerator, denominator, result, source table, and whether any formula components were missing from the retrieved context.
Shared conversations now render data attachments inline instead of hiding them behind CSV downloads, so table outputs can be inspected on mobile.
